title: Inert Win32 ActionJournal container storage boundary

path_policy.directory: absolute canonical drive-letter DOS path only
path_policy.ancestors: open existing with FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT, reject reparse, retain handles denying write and delete before any leaf create/open
path_policy.after_acquisition: all data and metadata operations use retained handles; pathname is used once more only for held-handle identity reopen proof

volume_policy.pre_leaf_check: validate the retained parent handle and held volume before CREATE_NEW or OPEN_EXISTING

security_policy.parent: existing fixed leaf parent must already satisfy the same private profile
security_policy.creation: absolute security descriptor is supplied atomically to CREATE_NEW

file_policy.identity: exact FILE_ID_INFO volume serial and 128-bit file ID stable before and after genesis/open and equal on pathname reopen
file_policy.sharing: write and delete sharing denied for retained file lifetime

genesis: new handle must report size zero
write exactly 33558528 zero bytes through bounded handle I/O
read back and verify every byte is zero
generate a nonzero 32-byte container ID with BCryptGenRandom system-preferred RNG
encode the exact 4096-byte merged container header and SHA-256 domain checksum
write the full header through the retained handle
read back and strictly decode the exact header
revalidate file, volume, DACL, ancestor, path, size, and identity before success
open_existing: validate file, volume, DACL, size, and caller-supplied trusted identity
read and strictly decode the exact immutable 4096-byte header
bind decoded container ID to the trusted identity
reopen the still-pinned fixed path and require exact file identity
revalidate every retained handle before success
residual_gates: remote Windows SDK compile and static analysis
native container codec integration without duplicating authority
authenticated foreground helper protocol and supervision
exact Windows crash, power-loss, filter-driver, and filesystem acceptance
